description: Typical saver award prices (one-way) by program, market and cabin from a researched table, plus known sweet spots. Markets cover trips from the US, Europe, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, Asia, the Middle East, India and Latin America. Each price carries its own as_of date and confidence. Programs that price dynamically with no published chart come back under not_priced, with the reason, rather than with a number. Use when live award search is unavailable, to shortlist programs, or to judge whether a live price is good. Prices are estimates; dynamic programs vary.

market.description: Where the trip starts and where it goes: us_ = from the US, eu_ = from Europe, ca_ = from Canada, au_ = from Australia or New Zealand, asia_ = from Asia, me_ = from the Middle East, in_ = from India, latam_ = from Latin America. *_north_asia = Japan/Korea/China/HK/Taiwan; eu_middle_east includes North and Central Africa; eu_africa = southern Africa. E.g. Sydney-Los Angeles is au_north_america.

programs.description: Program slugs to look up; empty array = all programs with a price for this market
